actionItems: Jeanne-Oui to deliver working technical-functional design by next meeting
Eileen to provide user requirement specification focusing on findability, ergonomics, and user behavior
keyPoints: Remote must be compact, multi-functional, and visually distinctive with trendy materials and shapes.
Added feature: detects darkness and triggers a fluorescent blink or beep to help users find lost remotes.
Design must justify €25 price with a feature set that aligns with market value and user needs.
Production cost capped at €12.50; international market with no regional restrictions.
summary.summary: The team finalizes a new remote control design that must be compact, multi-functional, and visually distinct to stand out in the market. A key feature is a lost-remote detection system using a light sensor to trigger a visible or audible signal in low-light environments. The design must balance cost (≤€12.50/unit) with functionality and user-friendliness, while marketing develops a user requirement specification focusing on findability and ergonomics.
summary.title: Remote Control Design Decisions
